label: ETF Double 7s
about: Index or sector ETF above its 200-day closes at a 7-day closing low. Buy the washout and sell when it closes at a 7-day high (Larry Connors' Double 7s).

source.title: Larry Connors' Double 7 Strategy: tested on SPY and 8 other markets (StrategyQuant)

label: ETF 3-Day Lower Highs & Lows
about: ETF in a long-term uptrend makes three straight lower highs and lower lows and closes under its 5-day average. Buy the third down day; exit on a close back above the 5-day average (Connors' 3-day high/low method).

label: Cumulative RSI(2) Washout
about: Stock or ETF above its 200-day where the last two days' RSI(2) readings add up to a deep oversold total. Buy the dip; exit when RSI(2) recovers above 70.

label: Bollinger %b 3-Day Washout
about: Uptrend stock or ETF closes in the bottom of its Bollinger band (%b low) three days running. Buy the exhausted selling; exit on a close above the 5-day average (Connors' %b strategy).

label: ADX Trend Pullback (Holy Grail)
about: Strong trend (ADX above 25-30, 50-day above 200-day) pulls back to touch the rising 20-day EMA. Buy at the EMA and target the recent swing high (Linda Raschke's Holy Grail, adapted to a limit entry).

label: Turn-of-the-Month ETF Drift
about: Month-end and early-month inflows (pay cheques, pension contributions) lift index ETFs. Buy near the close a few sessions before month end and hold into the first days of the new month.

source.title: Turn of the month in equity indexes (Quantpedia)

label: Turnaround Tuesday (Monday Down)
about: ETF in an uptrend closes down on a Monday, near the low of the day. Buy near Monday's close; sell on the first close above the prior day's high or after a few days (Turnaround Tuesday).

source.title: The Turnaround Tuesday trading strategy (Quantified Strategies)

label: 52-Week-High Leader Dip
about: Stocks trading near their 52-week high keep outperforming (George & Hwang). Buy a short, sharp dip in a stock within a few percent of its 52-week high; exit on the bounce.

source.title: The secret to momentum is the 52-week high (Alpha Architect)

label: Bull-Market Panic Buy (VIX Spike)
about: When VIX jumps well above its 20-day average while SPY is still above its 200-day, fear is usually overdone. Buy oversold uptrend ETFs into the spike; exit on the rebound.

source.title: When SPY pulls back and VIX spikes (Backtest substack)

label: Large-Cap Close-at-Low Snapback
about: The close-at-the-low (low IBS) effect applied to liquid, above-average-strength stocks in an uptrend: a down day that closes at the bottom of its range tends to bounce above that day's high.

source.title: The Internal Bar Strength indicator (Jonathan Kinlay)

label: Uptrend Gap-Down Reclaim
about: An uptrend stock gaps below the prior day's low but buyers step in and it closes above the open. The rejected lower prices often mark a short-term low; buy a small dip the next day and exit on strength.

source.title: Swing Desk in-house idea (failed-auction gap reversal)
